# The AI Search Playbook for Ecommerce

> A free, self-paced course by Team Empathy (teamempathy.co.nz), the Auckland
> AI search agency. It teaches Shopify ecommerce stores how to become the brand
> AI recommends: technical foundations, content, authority and measurement.
> 31 lessons across 5 modules. All lessons are free and open.

## Lessons

- [0.1 The new rules of discovery](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/0-1-the-new-rules-of-discovery/): How people find ecommerce brands has changed shape. Zero-click, AI shopping, and the entity-confidence thesis: in 2026 you optimise to become the brand AI recommends, not to rank a page.
- [0.2 Where you stand: your score out of 100](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/0-2-your-score-out-of-100/): Score your store against the AEO Maturity Model: four pillars, five levels, 100 points. Certified is 80. Here's how to place yourself honestly before you change a thing.
- [0.3 Plug Claude into your store](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/0-3-plug-claude-into-your-store/): Set up Claude as your always-on SEO analyst: connect it to your live Shopify store data, read-only, and every lesson in this playbook gets a prompt you can actually run.
- [0.4 The 30-minute quick-win audit](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/0-4-the-30-minute-quick-win-audit/): A fast, repeatable audit that finds the highest-impact fixes on your Shopify store and turns them into a ranked action plan before you start the real build.
- [1.1 Open the doors to AI crawlers](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-1-open-the-doors/): robots.txt, CDN and WAF settings, and llms.txt: how to stop accidentally blocking the AI crawlers that power ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI shopping answers.
- [1.2 Escape Shopify's URL traps](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-2-escape-shopifys-url-traps/): Duplicate product URLs, canonicals, index control and redirects: the Shopify-specific plumbing that quietly leaks rankings, and how to take back control.
- [1.3 Product pages that sell themselves](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-3-product-pages-that-sell-themselves/): Product titles, descriptions and variants that rank on Google and get quoted by AI, without the supplier copy that half your competitors also shipped.
- [1.4 Product schema and GTINs](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-4-product-schema-and-gtins/): Structured data and product identifiers: the single most-missed variable in ecommerce AI visibility. Get stars, prices and stock into your listings and get recommended by AI.
- [1.5 Collections: your biggest traffic pages](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-5-collections-your-biggest-traffic-pages/): Your collection pages target the broadest, highest-intent searches you can win. Most stores leave them empty. Fill them, tame the filters, and fix pagination.
- [1.6 Structure and internal links that feed your money pages](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-6-structure-and-internal-links/): Site architecture and internal linking on Shopify: make every page reachable, stop burying your best sellers, and funnel authority to the pages that make money.
- [1.7 Merchant feeds: the universal AI shopping key](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-7-merchant-feeds/): Google Merchant Center, Microsoft and beyond: your product feed is now an SEO channel that decides whether AI shopping surfaces can show your products at all.
- [1.8 Agentic storefronts: sell inside ChatGPT](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-8-agentic-storefronts/): Shopify now syndicates your catalogue into ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Copilot and Perplexity, and buyers can check out inside the chat. Set it up deliberately.
- [1.9 Speed and technical health](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/1-9-speed-and-technical-health/): Core Web Vitals, theme bloat, broken links and error pages: the technical hygiene that gates your rankings and keeps crawlers coming back.
- [2.1 Keywords with buying intent](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-1-keywords-with-buying-intent/): Stop guessing what to write. Find the searches with money behind them, and decide what your store actually needs to target across Google and AI.
- [2.2 Topic clusters: map what AI maps](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-2-topic-clusters/): Pillar and spoke architecture for ecommerce: organise your keyword map into clusters so engines and AI see you as the authority on your whole category.
- [2.3 Write for chunk retrieval](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-3-write-for-chunk-retrieval/): AI quotes passages, not pages. Answer-first structure, questions as subheadings, and formatting machines can lift: how to write content that gets cited.
- [2.4 Buying guides and comparisons AI quotes](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-4-buying-guides-and-comparisons/): The content formats AI assistants lean on hardest when recommending products: honest buying guides, comparison pages and FAQs that lead to a cart.
- [2.5 Drafting with Claude](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-5-drafting-with-claude/): A drafting workflow that produces content in your voice at scale: brand voice setup, structured briefs, and the honest limits of AI-drafted content.
- [2.6 Refresh and freshness cycles](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-6-refresh-and-freshness/): Find decaying content in Search Console, make substantial updates, and run the 90-day refresh rhythm that keeps your best pages compounding instead of fading.
- [2.7 Stitch it together with internal links](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/2-7-stitch-it-together/): Wire your clusters into the web AI can follow: pillar to spokes, spokes to products, and the linking audit that closes Module 2.
- [3.1 Why 77 percent](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/3-1-why-77-percent/): Only 23% of AI citations come from your own website. The other 77% come from third-party sources: reviews, forums, media. This module is how you earn them.
- [3.2 Review velocity on autopilot](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/3-2-review-velocity/): 50 recent reviews beat 800 old ones. Build the post-purchase sequence that generates a steady stream of specific, attribute-rich reviews, compliantly.
- [3.3 Third-party review platforms](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/3-3-third-party-review-platforms/): Trustpilot, Google, ProductReview and the platforms AI actually reads: where to build profiles, why crawlability is strange, and how to respond like a pro.
- [3.4 Reddit, Quora and the forums AI reads](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/3-4-reddit-quora-and-the-forums-ai-reads/): Reddit appears in up to 24% of AI answers and drives 4x higher ChatGPT citation rates. How to show up in communities credibly, without getting banned.
- [3.5 Digital PR and earned media](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/3-5-digital-pr-and-earned-media/): 48% of LLM citations come from earned media. Get into the roundups, the press and the publications AI trusts, without a PR agency retainer.
- [3.6 LinkedIn and founder presence](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/3-6-linkedin-and-founder-presence/): LinkedIn is a top-5 cited domain across AI platforms, and a founder's voice compounds brand trust. A sustainable cadence that doesn't eat your week.
- [4.1 Measure what matters](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/4-1-measure-what-matters/): Re-run your baseline, track AI share of voice and sentiment, and watch competitors: the measurement layer that tells you the system is working.
- [4.2 Prove the money](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/4-2-prove-the-money/): Find the traffic ChatGPT and Perplexity send you in GA4, tie it to revenue, and see whether AI visitors really do convert better. Spoiler: they do.
- [4.3 The operating rhythm](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/4-3-the-operating-rhythm/): The weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence that keeps the whole system compounding without eating your calendar: observe, decide, delegate.
- [4.4 The 100-day plan](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/4-4-the-100-day-plan/): The whole playbook sequenced into a day-by-day plan: foundations first, quick wins early, authority and AI proof compounding by day 100.
- [4.5 When to DIY, when to bring us in](https://playbook.teamempathy.co.nz/lessons/4-5-when-to-diy-when-to-bring-us-in/): An honest build-vs-buy guide: what this playbook gets you on your own, where the ceiling is, and what working with Team Empathy actually looks like.

## About
- [Team Empathy](https://teamempathy.co.nz): Search & AI visibility for ecommerce. We make Shopify brands the brand AI recommends.
